metadata.scenario: A telemarketer calls trying to sell office supplies. The receptionist politely declines and hangs up. Very short call, under 30 seconds.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, how can I help you today? Hi, this is David Anderson. I was referred by Dorothy Henderson. Oh, yes! Dorothy is a wonderful client. How can we assist you? Well, my wife is recovering from a stroke, and we need physical therapy and nursing care. I’m glad you reached out. We offer skilled nursing care and physical therapy services. That sounds good, but I need to learn more about the costs. Sure! Skilled nursing care is $95 to $125 per visit, and physical therapy is $110 to $140. Great, can you set up a consultation? I can arrange that for you, but first... Sorry, we’re not interested. Thank you! Goodbye! Um, excuse me? I’m still here! Let’s get back to your wife’s care. Okay, I’d like to set up the consultation, please. Great! I will connect you with Lisa Chen, our Care Coordinator. Perfect! What’s the best way to reach her? You can reach her directly at +13165559203. Thank you! I’ll call her shortly. You’re welcome! I’ll note down your interest in physical therapy and nursing care. Sounds good. I really appreciate your help today! My pleasure, David! We’ll look forward to assisting you and your wife. Thank you again. Bye! Goodbye!
